title: Orientation
description: auto follows the page's shape: a row of key caps in a wide box, a column of keys in a tall one. Resize the browser source / vosulay page / renderer layer and the layout re-flows.

title: Alignment
description: Which side of the box the keys hug when they do not fill it. right mirrors the layout (KPS tile on the left of the row; key labels on the right of the column) for pages on the right side of the screen.

title: KPS position
description: Where the keys-per-second readout sits. auto: beside the row (osu!, taiko, catch), above it in mania (the caps row then spans the page with the stage's column proportions: put the page directly over or under the stage), below the column in tall boxes.

title: Show KPS history
description: Bars of keys per second over the last 10 s; on the results screen, the whole attempt with its peak marked.

title: Show total taps
description: Sum of all key counts for the attempt.

title: Mania cap widths
description: skin: caps take the current skin's ColumnWidth / ColumnSpacing proportions (read through vosu), so a page as wide as the stage lines up with its columns. equal: same width for every key.

title: Backing
description: none: the caps float on the game. scrim: a soft dark fade behind them for very bright backgrounds. panel: an 18-LAB panel filling the page.

title: Accent colour
description: map: lit keys and the live KPS take the current map's colour (from its background, which is never shown). 18-lab: amber. Taiko drum keys keep don amber / kat blue.
